title: Prepare images and templates in one workspace
summary: Compress images, bring them into Quick Query, and validate notification templates with their Velocity Context.
notes: Compress PNG, JPEG, and WebP images with target file sizes, maximum dimensions, and side-by-side previews.
Compare available lossless and lossy results, download a batch as ZIP, or add selected images to Quick Query.
Send image attachments from Quick Query to Compress Image and restore saved image workspaces when you return.
HTML Template adds editable Velocity Context and notification API validation, with rendered results in the preview.
Search Settings and global search for configuration entries; manage testing environments and Oracle connections in grouped dialogs.
Administrators can publish selected settings to registered recipients from Dashboard; registered devices receive them automatically.
QR generation and TLV viewing now share one tool, and Image tools have their own sidebar group.

slides.title: Choose the image result that fits
slides.body: Add PNG, JPEG, or WebP images, set size limits, and compare available lossless and lossy results before choosing what to use.
bullets: Set a target file size and optional maximum dimensions.
Inspect images side by side with linked zoom and pan.
Download selected results individually or as a ZIP.

slides.title: Move images into Quick Query
slides.body: Send image attachments to Compress Image, then add the selected results to the Quick Query destination you choose.
bullets: Choose an existing query tab or create a new one.
Image workspaces are saved so you can return to them later.

slides.title: Validate notification templates with context
slides.body: Edit HTML and Velocity Context in separate panels, then validate through your configured notification endpoint and review the rendered response.
bullets: Keep context drafts with each document.
Review suggested missing fields before adding them.
Configure the notification endpoint in Settings.

tips.title: Add images to compress
tips.body: Choose PNG, JPEG, or WebP files, then set a target size or compress at the current settings.

tips.title: Find a setting
tips.body: Search for an environment, connection, or integration to jump to its settings.
